items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT for Week 5 (with Tank Bigsby also OUT). ETR flags Philly RB room shift; Levitan/Silva expect Will Shipley heavy usage vs JAX.
items.opportunity: Primary carries/routes to backups in London game

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT for Week 5. Confirmed across board; Tyler Huntley expected to start.
items.why: Ankle; final report and coach confirmation
items.implication: Ravens pass game capped; Flowers/Andrews limited upside
items.opportunity: Huntley start reduces dual-threat and deep targets

items.text: Jayden Daniels listed IN / expected to play after elbow issue. Full participant context.
items.why: Cleared final report; Rapoport video confirmation of return
items.implication: Commanders offense upgrade; McLaurin/Diggs context affected by Diggs OUT

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT (with Barkley and Hollywood Brown). Eagles pass catchers thinned significantly for London.
items.implication: WR targets consolidate to remaining options; Goedert elevated
items.opportunity: Increased target share for Goedert/Wicks etc.

items.text: Stefon Diggs OUT. Commanders WR room impacted alongside McLaurin Q.
Breece Hall OUT (with AD Mitchell). Jets backfield thinned.
items.implication: Backup RB opportunity; passing game adjustments

items.text: Mike Evans off injury report with no designation; fully clear for 49ers vs SEA. Bosa and Juszczyk OUT.
items.why: Removed from report; Shanahan comments positive on others

items.text: Jeremiyah Love not on final injury report (IN). Levitan projects much bigger workload than Week 4, 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier despite ankle maintenance; better role expected after prior criticism.
items.why: Cleared report; media/fan drag may force expanded role; full-go comments
items.implication: RB1 upside vs DET; clear lead over Allgeier

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (among others including Alt/James).
items.implication: LAC WR targets to McConkey/others; McConkey also Q
items.opportunity: Increased share for Ladd McConkey if active

items.text: Chris Olave listed IN (with Fant). Removed from uncertainty.
items.implication: Full WR role expected for Saints

items.text: Broncos place emerging WR Pat Bryant on short-term IR (ankle); misses next 4 games, eligible Week ~8 vs CAR. Humphrey promoted.
items.why: Ankle from prior game; source confirmation
items.implication: DEN WR depth hit; short-term absence

items.text: Levitan flags multi-factor long-term downside for Malik Nabers despite short-term play: knee issue, lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, and coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) style risks; notes frustration over late-game targets.
items.why: Stacked injury/QB/coaching risks beyond this week; practice miss for knee
items.implication: Monitor closely ROS; not pure smash
items.opportunity: Still high usage if healthy short-term

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Nico Collins vs TEN as his WR8; strong volume/red-zone and matchup driven.
items.why: Target hog + Titans defense struggles vs WRs; red-zone usage
items.opportunity: High target/route share in favorable spot

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; volume + matchup; pushing 'Brown Gobbler' nickname for target/fantasy gobbling.
items.why: Workload + soft MIA run defense; Bengals WR injuries may funnel more
